deps = Path(json.loads((archives / 'capabilities-baseline/manifest.json').read_text())['target_dir']) / 'release/deps'
command = ['rustc', '--test', '--edition=2024', '--crate-name', 'deadlib_audio_backend_alsa',
    '-C', 'opt-level=3', '-C', 'lto=fat', '-C', 'codegen-units=16', '-L', f'dependency={deps}']
for name in ['alsa', 'deadlib_audio_core', 'deadlib_platform', 'libc', 'log']:

    assert len(paths) == 1, (name, paths)
    command += ['--extern', f'{name}={paths[0]}']
command += [str(folder / 'lib.rs'), '-o', str(folder / 'alsa-tests')]
subprocess.run(command, check=True, cwd=root)
binary = str(folder / 'alsa-tests')
checks = []
def check(label, pattern, env):
    result = subprocess.run([binary, pattern, '--ignored', '--test-threads=1'],
        env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    assert '1 passed; 0 failed' in result.stdout, result.stdout
    checks.append(dict(scenario=label, output=result.stdout + result.stderr))
result = subprocess.run([binary, '--test-threads=1'], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
checks.append(dict(scenario='unit', output=result.stdout + result.stderr))

for layout in ['regular', 'empty', 'unmatched_default', 'bad_name', 'probe_error',
    'bad_card_info', 'bad_card_name', 'missing_card_name', 'long_names', 'empty_names']:
    check(layout, 'fixture_enumeration', {**fixture_env, 'ALSA_FIXTURE_LAYOUT': layout})
